# Slider

**Class:** `UltraCanvasSlider` · **Group:** [Buttons and choices](../Groups/Buttons-and-choices.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasSlider.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasSlider.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasSlider.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A value on a range

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSlider> CreateSlider( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float width, float height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSlider> CreateHorizontalSlider( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float width, float height, float min = 0.0f, float max = 100.0f);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSlider> CreateVerticalSlider( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float width, float height, float min = 0.0f, float max = 100.0f);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSlider> CreateCircularSlider( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float size, float min = 0.0f, float max = 100.0f);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSlider> CreateRangeSlider( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float width, float height, float min = 0.0f, float max = 100.0f, float lower = 25.0f, float upper = 75.0f);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasSlider(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasSlider(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasSlider(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onValueChanged` | `std::function<void(float)> onValueChanged` | _Value changed_ |
| `onValueChanging` | `std::function<void(float)> onValueChanging` | Called during drag |
| `onPress` | `std::function<void(const UCEvent&)> onPress` | _Press_ |
| `onRelease` | `std::function<void(const UCEvent&)> onRelease` | _Release_ |
| `onClick` | `std::function<void(const UCEvent&)> onClick` | _Click_ |
| `tickLabelFormatter` | `std::function<std::string(float)> tickLabelFormatter` | The label of a tick at a value (SetTickLabels); unset, the number. |
| `hoverText` | `std::function<std::string(float)> hoverText` | The text of the hover preview (SetHoverPreview); unset, the value formatted as the value display formats it. |
| `onLowerValueChanged` | `std::function<void(float)> onLowerValueChanged` | Lower handle value changed |
| `onUpperValueChanged` | `std::function<void(float)> onUpperValueChanged` | Upper handle value changed |
| `onRangeChanged` | `std::function<void(float, float)> onRangeChanged` | Range changed (both values) |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

| `MinAutoStepSpan` | `static constexpr float MinAutoStepSpan = 20.0f` | A range narrower than this many whole units gets a continuous default step: below ~20 positions a whole-unit slider is too coarse to be a slider at all (0..2 would offer three). |

## Option types in this header

### enum `SliderStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Horizontal` | Classic horizontal bar |
| `Vertical` | Classic vertical bar |
| `Circular` | Circular/knob style |
| `Progress` | Progress bar style |
| `Range` | Range slider with two handles |
| `Knob` | Rotary cap with a pointer line inside a ring of dots |
| `Field` | A field that fills with the value: a name on the left, the number on the right |
| `Seek` | Media timeline: thin line, buffered part, thumb shown on hover |
| `Ruler` | Fixed centre marker; the scale slides under it |
| `Segmented` | A row (or column) of blocks lit up to the value, like a level meter |

### enum `SliderValueDisplay`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoDisplay` | No value display |
| `Number` | Numeric value |
| `Percentage` | Percentage display |
| `Tooltip` | Show on hover |
| `AlwaysVisible` | Always visible (fixed X11 conflict) |
| `Bubble` | In a balloon over the handle, always |
| `BubbleWhileDragging` | In a balloon over the handle while it is dragged |

### enum `SliderTickPosition`

Where tick marks are drawn. Before is above a horizontal track and left of a vertical one; After is below / right. OnTrack draws them inside the track itself (with Dot, one dot per stop).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoTicks` |  |
| `Before` |  |
| `After` |  |
| `BothSides` |  |
| `OnTrack` |  |

### enum `SliderTickStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Line` | Straight marks; major ones longer than minor ones |
| `Ramp` | Marks that grow from the minimum to the maximum, so the scale says "more" |
| `Dot` | Round dots |

### struct `SliderColorZone`

A colour for the part of a Segmented slider (or its active fill) at and above a fraction of the range, e.g. {0.75f, amber}, {0.9f, red}.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `fromFraction` | `float fromFraction = 0.0f` |  |
| `color` | `Color color` |  |
